+/// Parse a span like `45`, `45s`, `10m`, `2h` or `1d` into a number of seconds.
+fn parse_interval_secs(input: &str) -> Result<u64, String> {
+    let input = input.trim();
+    let split_at = input
+        .find(|c: char| !c.is_ascii_digit())
+        .unwrap_or(input.len());
+    let (digits, unit) = input.split_at(split_at);
+    let amount: u64 = digits
+        .parse()
+        .map_err(|_| format!("Invalid interval '{input}': expected a number"))?;
+    let multiplier = match unit {
+        "" | "s" => 1,
+        "m" => 60,
+        "h" => 60 * 60,
+        "d" => 24 * 60 * 60,
+        other => return Err(format!("Invalid interval unit '{other}' in '{input}'")),
+    };
+    amount
+        .checked_mul(multiplier)
+        .ok_or_else(|| format!("Interval '{input}' is too large"))
+}
